## File: sgl-project_sglang/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/apps/webui/main.py

Prompts

```
['run the SGLang diffusion web UI server with a model path and generate images or videos via a Gradio interface', 'add CLI arguments for the SGLang diffusion web UI by extending an argparse parser with server and sampling parameters', 'generate images or videos from text prompts using the SGLang diffusion model with configurable parameters', 'resolve a model path to a valid Hugging Face or ModelScope repository ID', 'prepare a multimodal generation request and forward it to the scheduler client for inference']
```

Usage

```
{'run_sgl_diffusion_webui': 'run the SGLang diffusion web UI server with a model path and generate images or videos via a Gradio interface', 'add_webui_args': 'add CLI arguments for the SGLang diffusion web UI by extending an argparse parser with server and sampling parameters', 'generate_image_video': 'generate images or videos from text prompts using the SGLang diffusion model with configurable parameters', 'resolve_model_repo_id': 'resolve a model path to a valid Hugging Face or ModelScope repository ID', 'prepare_and_forward_request': 'prepare a multimodal generation request and forward it to the scheduler client for inference'}
```
